thread:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] Increased 502/503 responses reported for hosted API and Dedicated control plane after scheduled cert rotation. Some customers in eu-central and us-west seeing failures. Public status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1847701234

oncall-ali: Taking lead. what rotated and when? @deploy-bot any deploys at 06:20Z?

deploy-bot: Automated cert-rotation job ran at 06:22Z (cert-rotator v2.4). Targets: control-plane-proxy, token-issuer, dedicated-gateway. No other deploys.

eng-ops-sam: seeing TLS handshake failures between control-plane-proxy and token-issuer on a subset of hosts. Error: "x509: certificate signed by unknown authority". Rolling certs back to previous chain on affected hosts now.

infra-anna: isolating affected hosts: cp-proxy-4, cp-proxy-7, ded-gw-2. Putting ded-gw-2 in maintenance to avoid customer impact: ```rbacctl set-maintenance ded-gw-2 --reason "cert rollback"```

security-lee: confirming rotation job used new intermediate CA that was not added to downstream stores. we need to update trust bundle asap. adding to sprint, but emergency step now to reissue with previous CA.

eng-ops-sam: reissued certs with prior CA and reloaded proxies on cp-proxy-4/7 and ded-gw-2. Command sequence: ```for host in cp-proxy-4 cp-proxy-7 ded-gw-2; do scp certs/old-ca.pem $host:/etc/ssl/ca.pem && systemctl restart proxy; done```

support-omar: pushing a short customer notification via status and email: "We are investigating intermittent 502/503s for API requests in EU and US regions. Root cause appears related to certificate rotation. Mitigation steps in progress." Posting to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1847701234

incidents-bot: MITIGATION: rollback to previous CA complete on flagged hosts. Observed failed requests drop from ~12% -> ~1.5% across impacted regions. Continuing validation for 15m.

oncall-ali: temporary measures: paused cert-rotator job globally, applied alert suppression for noisy downstream cert alerts, and enabled additional TLS handshake logging for 1h.

product-zoe: contacting top 5 affected customers and offering 2 days of credits. drafting FAQ about why rotation failed and next steps.

security-lee: running verification across fleet to ensure no hosts still trusting new intermediate: ```find /etc/ssl -name '*.pem' -exec grep -H "NEW-INTERMEDIATE" {} \; || echo no-match``` Also filing follow-up: add automated trust bundle propagation to rotation pipeline.

eng-ops-sam: coordinating safe re-run of rotation with updated trust propagation. Plan: staging rollout -> canary certs only -> health-check gating. Holding off until postmortem.

infra-anna: maintenance windows scheduled for affected dedicated customers to validate connections. Ops runbook ref: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cert-rotation-failure

support-omar: created triage label on all open tickets and pinged account teams.

incidents-bot: STATUS: partial mitigation (recovering). public page updated. Next update in 10m or on any regression. Thread restricted to incident leads.

oncall-ali: postmortem owners assigned: @security-lee (root cause & pipeline), @eng-ops-sam (rollback & validation), @infra-anna (deployment controls). I'll publish timeline and RCA after stabilization.

product-zoe: approved customer credits. Please include credits note in final summary.

eng-ops-sam: collecting handshake traces and metrics (TLS error rate, successful handshakes by host) and saving to runbook for RCA.

incidents-bot: FINAL UPDATE: 1847701834 - Rollback succeeded across impacted hosts, rotation job disabled until pipeline is fixed. Incident state: resolved. Postmortem scheduled.
